1
Dekho Utha Hai Dahar Se Jafar Ka Janaza.
Ummat Ne De Diya Hai Risalat Ka Yeh Sila.
Yeh Kis Ne Mere Lal Ko Hai De Diya Zehar.
Giriya Yeh Fatima Ne Hai Taboot Par Kiya.

2
Qurba Se Bolo Kaisi Hai Mawaddat Tumhari.
Tum Ne Bhuja Diya Hai Imamat Ka Yeh Diya.
Logo Yateem Ho Gaye Kazim Imam Bhi.
Ummat Ne Zulm Aal Pe Kaisa Hai Dhaya Diya.

3
Masmoom Ke Janazay Pe Rota Jahan Hai.
Rukhsat Howa Jahan Se Baqir Ka Ladla.
Larzi Zameen Kaisi Qayamat Hai Aa Gayi.
 Farman Ashk Bar Hai Tera Qalam Howa.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/dekho-utha-hai-dahar-se-jafar-ka-janaza-tajpoints-e30567403bd60a69ecba.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for lyrics, numbers in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    blocks = lyrics.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == number and len(lines) == 5
assert 'ڈھایا دیا' in body and 'noUrdu' not in yaml and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in yaml
print('Verified three four-verse stanzas in each script.')
PY"
